WITH f AS (SELECT p.*,n.nspname,l.lanname,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('review_chapter_practice_binding','get_teaching_script_source_review','confirm_teaching_script_source_review','list_teaching_script_source_review_status','save_completion_policy_draft','publish_completion_policy_draft','create_teaching_content_skeleton','create_teaching_lesson_activity_binding')) OR (n.nspname='private' AND p.proname='is_platform_owner') OR (n.nspname='auth' AND p.proname='uid') OR (n.nspname='runtime_publish_private' AND p.proname='authoring_lock')),
 rows AS (SELECT f.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,f.nspname AS schema,f.owner,f.lanname AS language,f.proacl::text AS acl,f.prosecdef AS security_definer,f.provolatile AS volatility,f.proleakproof AS leakproof,f.proparallel AS parallel,f.proconfig AS config,pg_get_functiondef(f.oid) AS definition,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(f.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') AS definition_sha256,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,f.oid,'EXECUTE'))) FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('postgres','authenticated','service_role','anon')) AS privileges,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM aclexplode(coalesce(f.proacl,acldefault('f',f.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') AS public_execute FROM f)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows) ORDER BY signature) FROM rows),'readOnly',current_setting('transaction_read_only'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_platform_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles as profile
    where profile.id = (select auth.uid())
      and profile.global_role = 'platform_owner'
      and profile.role = 'platform_super_admin'
      and coalesce(profile.status, 'active') = 'active'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION runtime_publish_private.authoring_lock()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then
  raise exception 'PUBLICATION_AUTHORING_ISOLATION_REQUIRED' using errcode='40001';
 end if;
 perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(4171, 2);
end $function$

authUidMeaning: coalesce nonempty request.jwt.claim.sub, request.jwt.claims.sub cast to uuid; empty/missing => NULL; malformed values fail rather than authorize
searchPathAssessment: SAFE_FOR_AUDITED_BODY: empty fixed proconfig; all application relations/helpers schema-qualified; builtins resolve in pg_catalog; no user identifiers interpolated
tenantMembership: No student tenant-membership grant path; this is platform Owner authoring. Enable uses exact textbook student_app/chapter/version graph; disable uses app/chapter/revision CAS after Owner guard.
helperSecurity: private.is_platform_owner is postgres SECURITY DEFINER with fixed empty path and active platform owner/super-admin profile checks
runtime_publish_private.authoring_lock is postgres SECURITY DEFINER, requires READ COMMITTED and takes advisory xact lock
private.valid_textbook_grammar_card validates JSON, rejects malformed data; no caller identifier interpolation
exceptions: Guard first; invalid inputs; revision conflict; missing/unpublished association; changed/empty source; malformed grammar; isolation error. No catch/fallback or implicit authorization on error.
